main:1.text: Mother gave me this journal and made me promise to use it. So... I guess I just write everything down now? Should be plenty of time while Father chops down the trees she marked. Been a long while since I've gone anywhere with him... but this is what she wanted, so I guess we both better get used to it.

main:2.text: Father beat the stranger at our door, but we're not safe there anymore. Ready or not, we're heading for the mountain. We talked to the World Serpent! Though we don't understand him. When he moved, we saw lots of places to dock the boat... but I think our path to the mountain is the big bridge coming from the golden temple in the lake. We met another Dwarf - Brok's brother, Sindri.

main:3.text: The Black Breath---some sort of nasty-smelling magic---stopped us at the entrance to the mountain. The friendly Witch from the woods appeared and told us we need the Light of Alfheim, and she's going to help us get it.

main:4.text: We actually traveled to Alfheim, a whole other realm! But the Witch vanished----I hope she's okay! Now we have to find the light that lets us fill the Bifrost, so we can get back to Midgard and use it against the Black Breath. The Light Elves and Dark Elves are fighting an endless war over the light we need.

main:5.text: We dispelled the Black Breath with Light from Alfheim. Now we need to find a way up to the highest peak, where Mom wanted her ashes scattered. We made it inside the mountain! Now we need to find a way up to the highest peak, where Mom wanted her ashes scattered.

main:6.text: There's a lot happening! At the summit we met Mimir, who made us cut off his head, and said if we can bring him back to life he'll help us get to Jötunheim. Oh, and apparently GODS are looking for us----Baldur of Asgard and his nephews, the Sons of Thor! I'm so confused. But now we're heading back to the Witch to see if her magic can wake up Mimir's head. Turns out the nice Witch is the goddess Freya of the Vanir!

main:7.text: The Serpent says that to get to the REAL highest peak we need two things: the secret travel rune for Jötunheim, and a piece of a magic chisel to carve it with. First we're sailing off to find the chisel... The magic chisel we need a piece of is buried under a lot of ice (and a dead Giant stonemason). Father's got a plan to reach it. I hope it works!

main:8.text: We got to the chisel's tip, but Thor's awful sons Magni and Modi attacked us. Father put his axe through Magni's face and Modi ran away, but I got so angry I almost got sick again. I must fight it! We just need the travel rune to Jötunheim now, and we can finally scatter Mom's ashes...

main:9.text: Be strong, boy. Freya will care for you. I will do whatever she needs to save you.

main:10.text: Be strong, boy. Freya will care for you. I will do whatever she needs to save you. Father told me.... he's a god, and so am I. I guess not knowing was making me sick. He seems so ashamed, I guess because of how much he hates gods... but Mom always said some of them were good. Anyway----back to Týr's vault to find the Black Rune.

main:11.text: The Black Rune and the Stone Mason's Chisel are ours! Now we just have to find a way back up to the mountain's summit, and we can use them to open the bridge to Jötunheim.

main:12.text: I've really messed everything up. I killed Modi for what he said about Mom, but Father got angry and we kept arguing all the way to the summit. Then Baldur found us, and in the fighting, we destroyed our path to Jötunheim. Now we've been sucked into the far side of Hel, and somehow we need to get out of here before we freeze. The boat works just like those flying lanterns in the mountain!

main:13.text: We found a hidden clue thanks to Mimir's special sight! There's a secret door in the temple, and we're going to see Brok to make us the key to get inside. Brok and Sindri made us the key to enter Týr's hidden chamber. I have a feeling it's that door downstairs by the water, on the round part of the temple.

main:14.text: We flipped the temple and found the Unity Stone, which Mimir says should let us go off the path when we're talking on the World Tree in the Realm Between Realms. This is getting crazy... but if it gets us to Jötunheim, we've come too far to quit now! Somehow Týr and the Giants hid the Jötunheim travel tower in the Realm Between Realms! The Unity Stone got us here... but can it get the tower home?

main:15.text: We restored the Jötunheim tower! Now we can travel there from the Realm Travel Room in Týr's Temple. Finally we'll fulfill Mom's wish.... The trip to Jötunheim failed because we don't have a travel crystal. We could use Mimir's eyes if he only had them both, but Odin ran off with one. We're going to see what Brok and Sindri know about it... We need Mimir's eye to travel to Jötunheim.

main:16.text: It's over now. The spell on Baldur was broken by the mistletoe arrow holding up my quiver (of all things)! Freya brough back Thamur the Stone Mason to stop us, but Jörmungandr helped us beat him. We beat Baldur together, and we would have let him go, but he tried to kill Freya... and I guess she was alright with that, but we weren't.

main:17.text: It was no accident, Mom sent us to Jötunheim. She knew everything that was going to happen... everything that HAD to happen. Mother was a Giant. The last "guardian" in Midgard. I guess she couldn't tell us... but now she wanted us to know. She wanted me to see I have a destiny, but I'm not really sure what it all means yet. Maybe we'll head home now, or maybe we'll see who needs our help.

side:3.text: Hammer Fall is one of many Wayward spirit side-quests. It is given by a vengeful spirit in Midgard, who wants Kratos to bring down the statue of Thor. It's important to note that this statue is not the one that Jörmungandr ate. This is a completely different statue, made of (oxidized) bronze or copper.

side:8.text: Prove your Valor is one of three Valkyrie favors in God of War (2018) and is the first Valkyrie side-quest in the game. The main objective is to defeat each of the corrupted Valkyries located throughout the majority of the Nine Realms. We found a Valkyrie, but something's wrong with her, is this a fight were ready for? We managed to beat the Valkyrie we found, but it wasn't easy.

side:9.text: The High Council is the second of three Valkyrie side-quests in God of War (2018). In this favor, Kratos has to go to the Council of Valkyries and place each of the Valkyrie Helmets on the council thrones in order to be able to fight Sigrún, the Valkyrie Queen and the final corrupted Valkyrie. Eight Valkyries. All we have to do is find them, defeat them, collect their helmets, and take them to the High Council.

side:10.text: God vs. Queen is the third and final Valkyrie favor in God of War (2018), where Kratos and Atreus have to fight and defeat the Valkyrie Queen Sigrún, the strongest of all the corrupted Valkyries. We've fought and freed her eight sisters, now it's time to take on the Queen herself.

side:11.text: Second Hand Soul is one of many Dwarven Favors in God of War (2018). It is the first side-quest given to Kratos by Brok, in which the former was tasked with finding the latter's friend Andvari in the Völunder Mines. Brok just asked us to find his Alchemist friend, Andvari, at the Völunder Mines. Father isn't big on helping people for no reward, but Brok DID just give us the entry stone to the Mines...

side:12.text: Deus Ex Malachite is one of many Dwarven Favors in God of War (2018). It is the second and final side-quest given by Brok to Kratos, where the Spartan is now tasked with finding Andvari's Hammer in the Landsuther Mines, all the while, Andvari's green ring, which contains his soul, was taken along on the quest. Brok thinks he knows where we might find his dead friend Andvari (the Dawrf whose hand we found).

side:14.text: Family Business is one of many Dwarven Favors in God of War (2018). It is the second and final side-quest given to Kratos and Atreus by Sindri, who then requested that they retrieve Fafnir's whetstone at the Northri Stronghold, after using the Reaver Spirit's dagger to trace the Hræzla Farmaðr clan. Sindri used the sigil on the knife we brought him to trade the Reavers to the Northri Stronghold.

side:15.text: Hail to the King is one of many Dwarven Favors and by all accounts the final one in God of War (2018). It is the only side-quest to be given by both Brok and Sindri, who now asked Kratos and Atreus with retrieving three legendary ingredients at Konùnsgard for the creation of the legendary Dvegræðikr armor. Completing this quest will make Brok's Royal Dwarven Set and Sindri's Royal Dwarven Set available for purchase.

boss:4.text: This article contains lore based on real-life sources from Norse mythology as introduced from the God of War Norse era. Baldur (Old Norse: Baldr, Nordic: ᛒᚨᛚᛞᚢᚱ), also known as Baldur Odinson (Translation: Baldur, Son of Odin), and also known as the Stranger, was the Norse Aesir God of Light, Peace, Beauty, and Goodness as well as Prince of Asgard.

boss:5.text: This article contains lore based on real-life sources from Norse mythology as introduced from the God of War Norse era. Gunnr is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Gunnr eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Midgard.
